split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before metaprogramming expansion, synthesized artifact, module replay, interop call, FFI metadata, closure/error boundary, runtime acceptance report, generated artifact, package proof, source-owner contract, or public workflow
split_policy.positive_rule: metaprogramming and interop closure rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners over hand-authored fixtures; generated reports, artifacts, labels, and provenance rows are never positive support by themselves
split_policy.provenance_rule: runtime reports, runnable conformance/e2e summaries, package manifests, bridge JSON, runtime-import artifacts, module replay rows, FFI metadata rows, closure/error composition summaries, cache snapshots, generated bridge payloads, public command wrappers, and source-owner contracts are provenance-only until a phase owner claims the behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: compatibility, shim, fallback, old-mode, migration-only, unsupported property behavior combination, unsupported foreign loader topology, public ABI widening, stale acceptance, evidence-log, generated-only, and generated-evidence-log claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.evidence_boundary_rule: parser/sema/lowering/IR/runtime/e2e behavior, metaprogramming expansion, synthesized artifacts, module replay, interop calls, FFI metadata, closure/error boundaries, acceptance reports, package proof, public workflow routing, generated bridge payloads, runtime-import artifacts, and cache snapshots are distinct evidence classes; only the behavior owner may promote a row to positive support
